h:
ComfyUI 中默认的 ZImageTurbo txt2img 工作流程非常简单直观，但有时它缺少我们可能需要的某些功能，例如加载 LoRA 模型或使用升级器进一步处理图像输出的能力。

其实解决办法很简单：右键点击t2i节点，然后——

没关系，我已经为您完成了这些步骤 - 您所需要做的就是单击“下载”按钮。

（实际上，我为一位像我一样刚接触 ComfyUI 的朋友制作了这个，但我认为也将其上传到 Civitai 会很好，对吧？）

此工作流程只是在默认工作流程中添加了一个 LoRA 加载器、一个放大器和两个图像预览器。如果你不需要任何额外的魔法，这应该足够了。由于它非常简单，您也可以轻松地向其中添加自己的节点。

o.en:
The default ZImageTurbo txt2img workflow in ComfyUI is very simple and intuitive, but sometimes it lacks certain features we might need, such as the ability to load LoRA models or further process the image output using an upscaler.

Actually, the solution is very simple: just right-click the t2i node, and then—

Never mind, I’ve already taken care of those steps for you—all you need to do is click the “Download” button.

(I actually made this for a friend who, like me, is new to ComfyUI, but I thought it would be nice to upload it to Civitai too, right?)

This workflow simply adds a LoRA loader, an upscaler, and two image previewer to the default workflow. If you don’t need any extra magic, this should be plenty. Since it’s so simple, you can easily add your own nodes to it as well.
